turns.patient_opening: Doctor: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on? Patient: My left leg has been hurting more and more for about two months, and it’s getting so bad it keeps me from sleeping. A week before it started, I got hit on the leg by a baseball and it became red and swollen, and ibuprofen hasn’t helped.

turns.doctor_question: I understand. To help me get a better picture of your current health, have you noticed any changes in your eyesight, such as blurriness, dark spots, or any loss of vision?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I haven’t noticed any changes in my vision—no blurriness, dark spots, or loss of vision.

turns.doctor_question: To help me get a better picture of your overall health, could you tell me if you currently smoke or have a history of smoking?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I don’t smoke, and I’ve never smoked.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand. To help me get a better picture of how you're feeling, have you been experiencing any nausea or feeling sick to your stomach lately?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any nausea or felt sick to my stomach lately.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand. To help me get a better picture of your health, have you noticed any lumps or masses in your breast area that do not cause you any pain?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any lumps or masses in my breast area.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand that physical symptoms can often be linked to how we are feeling emotionally. Lately, have you been experiencing a significant amount of stress or feeling under a lot of pressure?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I don’t feel especially stressed or under a lot of pressure—my main issue is the worsening left leg pain that started after the baseball hit and is affecting my sleep.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand. To help me get a better picture of your symptoms, have you noticed if your urine has been darker than usual lately?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed my urine being darker than usual.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand that finding a change in your breast can be concerning. To help me better understand what you are experiencing, have you noticed if the mass has been growing or changing in size rapidly over a short period of time?
turns.patient_answer: “No, there haven’t been any lumps or masses in my breast area at all—so nothing has been changing in size.”

turns.doctor_question: I'm sorry to hear you're not feeling well. To help me better understand what might be going on, could you tell me if you have been experiencing any pain in your wrist?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any pain in my wrist—it's just my left leg that’s been getting worse since the baseball hit.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand. To help me get a clearer picture of what’s going on, could you please check your arms for me? Have you noticed any skin lesions, such as rashes, bumps, or discoloration, running along the path of your veins?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any rashes, bumps, or discoloration along the veins on my arms.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand. To help me get a better picture of your health, I’d like to ask about your breathing: Do you find that you experience any shortness of breath or difficulty catching your breath when you are physically active, such as walking or climbing stairs?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I haven’t had shortness of breath when I’m active, and I can breathe normally when walking or climbing stairs.
